development_source: four original Salamander development notes only
octave_prior_policy: Add 0.3 times absolute octave distance from audio-derived YIN to reconstruction loss at selection only; choose on development before evaluation. No labels enter fitting.
evaluation_policy: No changes to frozen algorithm or configuration after independent evaluation; retain all outcomes and note errors. Assembled sequences are controlled samples, not human performances. Dynamics are timbral conditions after per-note peak normalisation.
